dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and continuous 2D geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical indentation on the left lateral margin at approximately mid-body; right margin is obscured by shadow and water turbidity.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with low-intensity blue-grey shading in non-specular regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High spatial frequency of minute, localized dark-pixel clusters (speckles) concentrated heavily on the posterior half of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp gradient slope between the depigmented white baseline and the distinct, high-contrast dark speckles.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Extensive distribution of high-contrast, point-like dark pigmented marks across the dorsal plane, particularly dense toward the tail.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Prominent longitudinal shadow-casting ridge along the central dorsal axis indicating a structural topographical deviation.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and dense fine-grained dark spotting pattern localized on the posterior dorsal region.
